verdict.rationale: Gitleaks is a secret-scanning tool, and such a tool could plausibly publish official SDKs or a library API, so the axis applies. The evidence documents only CLI commands (git, dir, stdin), a pre-commit hook, and a GitHub Action. Being installable via Go is not an official SDK, and no SDK or client library is documented, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
